title: Table A.3: Weak and nuclear $\beta^-$ decay $Q$-values ($\mathcal{L}_1\text{--}\mathcal{L}_3$, 80-digit Fréchet--Jacobian atlas)
html:
Archimedean specialisation. Weak and nuclear \beta^- decay Q-values at q_0^{(p)} (80-digit precision), evaluated strictly at the canonical Markov parameter z = q_0^3/(q_0^2+1) with zero fitted parameters. For heavy shells (N > 28), the (1^3) Pauli projector vanishes identically on TL_3(q_0) (y_{(1^3)} = 0); closing the shell-dressing factor beyond the bare monotone transfer chain remains open.
